At Callen, we turn your dreams into reality with custom home remodeling solutions that combine luxury, elegance, and unparalleled craftsmanship. Our unique design-build approach ensures your vision is at the heart of every project, transforming spaces into stunning, functional works of art.

From full-scale kitchen and bathroom renovations to beautifully crafted living areas and energy-efficient Infinity® Windows , our expert team will guide you every step of the way, bringing your unique style and personality to life. Experience the Callen difference—where timeless beauty, precision, and impeccable quality meet.

VISION

We work with you every step of the way, from conception to completion, to bring your vision to life.

Our team of experts simplifies the building process and delivers exceptional results. As a premier home remodeling expert with a reputation for quality, our professional project management, skilled craftsmen, attention to detail, and communication throughout the entire process transforms your vision into reality.

LIVE

Our commitment to quality and durability means that every Callen home remodeling project delivers lasting value and satisfaction. Let us elevate your surroundings, enrich your experiences, and transform your space to reflect your taste and lifestyle.

Callen Expands to Delafield: Bringing Luxury Home Remodeling Closer to Lake Country
May 26, 2026
CALLEN EXPANDS TO DELAFIELD: BRINGING LUXURY HOME REMODELING TO LAKE COUNTRY

Delafield has long been known for its scenic lakes, upscale neighborhoods, and homes that reflect both character and craftsmanship. As more homeowners in Lake Country invest in upgrading their spaces, the demand for high-end remodeling experiences continues to grow. Now, that experience is becoming more accessible than ever.

WHY DELAFIELD IS THE PERFECT FIT

Located in the heart of Lake Country, Delafield offers a unique blend of natural beauty and refined living. Homes here aren’t just places to live; they’re long-term investments, gathering spaces, and reflections of personal style. With that comes a need for remodeling solutions that go beyond surface-level updates. Homeowners are looking for thoughtful design, lasting materials, and a seamless process from concept to completion.

WHAT LUXURY REMODELING MEANS TODAY

Luxury home remodeling in Southeastern Wisconsin has evolved. It’s no longer just about aesthetics; it’s about how a space functions, feels, and adapts to everyday life.

Modern remodeling priorities often include:

Personalized kitchen spaces designed for both entertaining and daily use
Spa-inspired bathrooms that offer relaxation and efficiency
Energy-efficient upgrades like window replacement and door replacement
(including patio, storm, and entry doors)
Interior remodeling that maximizes both comfort and style

For homeowners in Delafield and throughout Lake Country, these upgrades are about creating a home that truly works for them.

BRINGING DESIGN AND BUILD TOGETHER

One of the biggest shifts in the remodeling industry is the move toward integrated design-build experiences. Instead of coordinating multiple vendors, homeowners are choosing streamlined approaches that combine design, planning, and remodeling under one roof.

This approach simplifies communication, improves timelines, and ensures every detail is aligned from the beginning. It also allows homeowners to fully visualize their project before their transformation begins, which is an advantage that reduces uncertainty and leads to better outcomes.

A CLOSER LOOK AT LOCAL REMODELING TRENDS

In Delafield, remodeling projects often reflect the surrounding environment. Homes near the water may focus on maximizing views and natural light, while others emphasize warm, inviting interiors that balance modern design with traditional elements. These projects aren’t just upgrades; they’re transformations that improve how homeowners live every day.

THE IMPORTANCE OF A LOCAL PRESENCE

Having a remodeling contractor rooted in the Delafield area means more than convenience. It means understanding the homes, the environment, and the expectations of local homeowners. From navigating seasonal challenges to recommending materials that perform well in Wisconsin weather, local expertise plays a key role in successful remodeling projects. It also makes the entire process more accessible, giving homeowners the opportunity to collaborate more closely and confidently.

A NEW OPPORTUNITY FOR HOMEOWNERS

With expanded access to high-end remodeling services in Delafield, homeowners now have the opportunity to approach their projects with a Design Center with curated displays featuring Kohler, Starmark Cabinetry, Infinity by Marvin, ProVia, and HomeStory Doors.Whether it’s a full home remodeling vision or targeted upgrades like kitchen remodeling or bathroom remodeling, the focus remains the same: creating spaces that are both beautiful and functional.

READY TO STEP INTO WHAT IS POSSIBLE?

Centered in the heart of Lake Country, our Delafield location brings the full Callen experience right to your neighborhood. With a focus on craftsmanship, thoughtful design, and a seamless experience, the path to a better home has never been clearer.

More than a Design Center, it is a space designed to spark ideas and make your vision tangible. Our team is here to guide you through design possibilities you may not have imagined – and help you move from inspiration to intention. Visit our Design Center to experience materials, layouts, and ideas firsthand, and connect with our team of Sales •Design Consultants to start shaping your vision.

KITCHENS
WHAT IS DESIGN BUILD?

Design-build is a streamlined and comprehensive approach to the creation and renovation of kitchens. With Callen, we manage both the design and construction aspects of your project. This integrated approach offers numerous benefits to clients, ensuring a smoother and more efficient journey from conception to completion. Experience the Callen difference and transform your kitchen with ease and expertise.

DESIGN

Conceptualization and Planning – The process begins with a collaborative discussion in our design center between you and your Sales • Design Consultant.

BUILD

Construction – Once the kitchen design is finalized and the budget is agreed upon, the construction phase begins. The same design-build team handles construction.

LIVE

Lasting Value – At Callen, we provide beautiful and functional kitchens that last a lifetime. Our commitment to quality and durability means every Callen home remodeling project delivers lasting value and satisfaction.

Design – Upon completion of the retainer agreement, your Sales • Design Consultant takes your input and creates detailed kitchen plans, drawings, and 3D views that bring your vision to life. This phase involves selecting finish materials, colors, space layout, and fixtures that align with your preferences and budget. The design-build approach ensures that practicality, aesthetics, and functionality are seamlessly integrated into the kitchen design.

‍

Budgeting and Cost Estimation – The design-build team provides an accurate cost estimate based on the kitchen design. Since the same team is responsible for both design and construction, they have a total understanding of how design choices impact costs, resulting in a more accurate budget assessment.

ABOUT CALLEN

Originally started in 1986 by two brothers, Callen has been providing home remodeling services to Southeastern Wisconsin residents for almost four decades. Under new ownership since 2023, our aim is to assure clients that we hold great respect for Callen’s legacy and heritage, while also being dedicated to moving the company forward to embrace the incredible amount of progress and innovation in building science and installation techniques. We are excited to have you, our clients, as part of this journey, and we look forward to serving you with the same level of excellence and commitment that Callen has always been known for.

Clear communication and responsive support from start to finish

HOME IMPROVEMENT EXPERTS IN DELAFIELD, WI

Discerning homeowners in Delafield, Wisconsin, turn to Callen for residential remodeling that reflects elegance, intention, and long-term value. Delafield Homeowners have a Design Center close by for inspiration and assistance. Known for a refined design-build process and elevated craftsmanship, Callen specializes exclusively in high-end residential renovation. Every home is approached as a complete environment, thoughtfully designed and expertly built to enhance daily living.

As trusted home improvement experts and home renovation specialists, Callen partners with homeowners who expect precision, transparency, and exceptional results from start to finish.

A REFINED DESIGN-BUILD PROCESS

Every remodeling project begins inside the Design Center, where homeowners collaborate directly with Callen’s Sales • Design Consultants, Project Managers, and carpentry team. This integrated process allows design, planning, and construction considerations to align from the very beginning, ensuring no detail is overlooked.

Rather than isolated updates, Callen delivers fully designed renovations that prioritize flow, balance, and cohesion throughout the home. This approach creates a smoother experience for the homeowner while producing refined, lasting results.

KITCHEN REMODELING DESIGNED AS A COMPLETE EXPERIENCE

Kitchen remodeling with Callen is rooted in full design, not partial upgrades. Each kitchen is planned as a complete space, accounting for layout, storage, lighting, cabinetry, and surface selections together. This ensures kitchens feel purposeful, elegant, and suited to both daily routines and entertaining.

Callen incorporates premium materials such as Starmark Cabinets, Ultracraft Cabinets, and Kohler faucets, selected to deliver durability and visual sophistication while complementing the home’s overall architectural style. If you are unsure of which styles will best suit your home, our Sales • Design Consultants can show you examples of our previous work and make suggestions that will elevate your home.

BATHROOM REMODELING WITH COMFORT AND LONGEVITY IN MIND

Bathrooms are designed as personal retreats that balance beauty with performance. Callen provides fully designed bathroom renovations that consider layout efficiency, moisture control, material durability, and long-term comfort as a unified plan. High-performance surfaces like Onyx are used for their clean appearance and lasting reliability, allowing bathrooms to maintain their elegance while supporting everyday use.

INTERIOR SPACES THOUGHTFULLY REIMAGINED

Beyond kitchens and bathrooms, Callen enhances interior living through fully designed renovations of main floors, laundry rooms, mudrooms, and attic conversions. These projects are carefully integrated into the home’s overall design language to ensure seamless transitions between spaces. Interior remodeling focuses on improving organization, flow, and usability while preserving a refined aesthetic throughout the home.

PREMIUM WINDOW INSTALLATION BUILT FOR STRENGTH

Callen installs Infinity® by Marvin® windows, manufactured from Ultrex fiberglass and engineered to be 8x stronger than vinyl. These windows offer superior durability, energy efficiency, and design flexibility for luxury homes.

All window services are installation-only. Callen does not perform repairs and will cut new openings when required to support the design vision. All window types are available except egress and skylights.

PRECISION DOOR INSTALLATION FOR REFINED HOMES

Door installation services are delivered with accuracy and efficiency. Callen installs ProVia entry and storm doors, HomeStory interior doors, and patio doors. HomeStory interior doors are laser-measured for precise fit and are not full-frame replacements, allowing for a clean, efficient installation.

All door services are installation-only, ensuring focus on craftsmanship and long-term performance.

SERVING DELAFIELD HOMEOWNERS WITH ELEVATED STANDARDS

Callen’s residential remodeling that reflects discipline, craftsmanship, and refined design. From the first Design Center consultation to final completion, every project is managed with care, professionalism, and attention to detail.

INTERIOR SPACES
WHAT IS DESIGN-BUILD?

Design-build is a streamlined and comprehensive approach to the creation and renovation of interior spaces. With Callen, we manage both the design and construction aspects of your project. This integrated approach offers numerous benefits to clients, ensuring a smoother and more efficient journey from conception to completion. Experience the Callen difference and transform your interior living space with ease and expertise.

DESIGN

Conceptualization and Planning – The process begins with a collaborative discussion in our design center between you and your Sales • Design Consultant.

BUILD

Construction – Once the interior living space design is finalized and the budget is agreed upon, the construction phase begins. The same design-build team handles construction.

LIVE

Lasting Value – At Callen, we provide beautiful and functional interior spaces that last a lifetime. Our commitment to quality and durability means every Callen home remodeling project delivers lasting value and satisfaction.

Design – Upon completion of the retainer agreement, your Sales • Design Consultant takes your input and creates detailed interior living space plans, drawings, and 3D views that bring your vision to life. This phase involves selecting finish materials, colors, space layout, and fixtures that align with your preferences and budget. The design-build approach ensures that practicality, aesthetics, and functionality are seamlessly integrated into the interior living space design.
‍

Budgeting and Cost Estimation – The design-build team provides an accurate cost estimate based on the bathroom design. Since the same team is responsible for both design and construction, they have a total understanding of how design choices impact costs, resulting in a more accurate budget assessment.

INFINITY BY MARVIN FIBERGLASS REPLACEMENT WINDOWS
OVERVIEW

Transform your home with Infinity® fiberglass replacement windows , combining beauty and unmatched strength. Crafted from Ultrex® fiberglass, these windows are 8x stronger than vinyl and 3.5x stronger than wood, offering superior durability and aesthetic appeal.

Ultrex® fiberglass was designed to be the most durable material in the window industry, allowing Infinity to build narrower frames for more expansive views. This exceptional strength also ensures a tight fit in any climate, resisting the risk of leaks, seal failures, and stress cracks. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty, Infinity Windows offers lasting performance and peace of mind.

OVERVIEW

Callen offers carefully curated product lines such as ProVia steel and fiberglass entry doors. ProVia products are known for being manufactured to the highest standards of durability, energy efficiency, and security. Replacing your old doors with ProVia products will not only transform your home’s look but they will also provide comfort with increased security and efficiency.

Choose from three lines of fiberglass doors that capture the genuine look and feel of wood grain combined with the longevity and maintenance-free benefits of durable fiberglass.

ProVia steel entry doors are available in either a wood grain texture or a smooth, skillfully painted finish. In addition to being beautifully finished, ProVia entry doors provide exceptional resilience and superior energy efficiency.
